The picker needs the All files access permission. Open the settings and turn the permission on.
If the settings screen does not open, connect with ADB and run:\nadb shell appops set %1$s MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE allow
This app is a file and folder picker for apps that use the Storage Access Framework. Give the app All files access, then start any app that opens or saves files.

Android blocks access to the Android/data and Android/obb folders. With root support, this app uses root to open these folders.

A calling app can read private data of other apps if you share files from these folders. Turn on this function only if you trust the apps that you use with this picker.

The picker asks you each time that you share a protected file.
